o: 17 Arjuna Awards and no Khel Ratna
a Khel Ratna for two athletes
questions.e: The National Sports Awards 2025 list named 17 Arjuna awardees with no Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna conferred that year. ⚠verify

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Which country won the open section gold at the 2026 Chess Olympiad in Samarkand?
questions.e: Hosts Uzbekistan won the open gold with 20/22 match points; India took silver on tiebreaks and Germany bronze.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: India's medal in the open section of the 2026 Chess Olympiad was —
questions.e: India won silver in the open section at Samarkand 2026 (tiebreak over Germany) and bronze in the women's section.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: The women's gold at the 2026 Chess Olympiad was won by —
questions.e: China won its seventh women's Olympiad gold; Kazakhstan took silver and India bronze.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: At the 2026 Chess Olympiad, world champion D. Gukesh scored —
questions.e: Gukesh scored 8.5/11 on top board for India; Uzbekistan's Abdusattorov scored 8/11 with a 2900 performance rating.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Eleven-year-old Bodhana Sivanandan made news at the 2026 Chess Olympiad by —
o: earning the WGM title and a second IM norm
questions.e: England's Bodhana Sivanandan (11) earned the Woman Grandmaster title and her second IM norm at Samarkand 2026.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: The FIFA World Cup 2026 final was won by —
questions.e: Spain beat Argentina 1–0 after extra time on 19 July 2026 at New Jersey, winning their second World Cup.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: The winning goal of the FIFA World Cup 2026 final was scored by —
questions.e: Substitute Ferran Torres scored in the 106th minute (assisted by Nico Williams) to give Spain the 1–0 extra-time win over Argentina.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Spain's captain at the FIFA World Cup 2026, who also won the Golden Ball, was —
questions.e: Captain Rodri led Spain to the title and was named the tournament's best player (Golden Ball).

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: India won the 2026 ICC Men's T20 World Cup final by —
questions.e: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs in the final at Ahmedabad (8 March 2026), winning a record third T20 World Cup.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: The Player of the Series at the 2026 ICC Men's T20 World Cup was —
questions.e: Sanju Samson was Player of the Series; Sahibzada Farhan (383) scored the most runs while Bumrah and Varun Chakravarthy took 14 wickets each.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: India's 2026 T20 World Cup triumph was historic because India became —
o: the first Asian team to win
the first host nation to win and the first back-to-back champion
the first to win without losing a toss
questions.e: India became the first host to win the Men's T20 World Cup and the first team to defend the title successfully (2024 and 2026).

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: India won the Asia Cup 2025 final by —
questions.e: India chased 147 to beat Pakistan by 5 wickets in the Asia Cup 2025 final (Dubai, 28 September 2025) — the first-ever India-Pakistan final — winning a record-extending 9th title.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Tilak Varma's contribution in the Asia Cup 2025 final was —
questions.e: Tilak Varma's unbeaten 69 guided India's chase in the final; Abhishek Sharma (314 runs) was Player of the Series and Kuldeep Yadav took 17 wickets.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: India won the Women's Asia Cup 2026 by beating —
o: Bangladesh in the final at Dhaka
Pakistan in the final at Colombo
Sri Lanka in the final at Dubai
Thailand in the final at Bangkok
questions.e: India beat Sri Lanka in the Women's Asia Cup 2026 final in Dubai on 13 September 2026.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: At the 2026 Asian Games, India's women cricketers won gold by —
questions.e: India's women beat Sri Lanka by 147 runs in the Asian Games final (22 September 2026) — the biggest win in a women's T20I final — with Mandhana's 79 and Deepti Sharma's 3/6.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Who became only the second batter after Sachin Tendulkar to reach 15,000 ODI runs?
questions.e: Virat Kohli reached 15,000 ODI runs with an unbeaten 139 off 88 balls in India's eight-wicket win over West Indies in the 1st ODI on 27 September 2026; it was his 86th international century, and Shubman Gill (110) shared a 151-run stand as India chased 296 with 50 balls to spare.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Who became the first women's batter to complete 11,000 international runs?
questions.e: Smriti Mandhana crossed 11,000 international runs on 22 September 2026 during the Asian Games women's cricket gold-medal final against Sri Lanka, going past Mithali Raj (10,868); she scored 79 off 45 balls as India won by 147 runs.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Which team became the first in the world to record 200 T20I wins?
questions.e: India recorded its 200th T20I win on 22 September 2026, beating Japan by two runs in a rain-reduced five-overs-a-side match at the Sano International Cricket Ground.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: Who was appointed Chairperson of the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) in September 2026?
questions.e: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet appointed Mandeep K Bhandari, a 2001-batch AGMUT-cadre IAS officer, as CBSE Chairperson on 25 September 2026; he was Principal Secretary to the Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir.

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: Under the Durga EV Auto scheme approved by the Delhi Cabinet in September 2026, how many electric autos will be allotted?
questions.e: The Delhi Cabinet approved the Durga EV Auto scheme on 23 September 2026: 1,300 pink electric autos, with 1,170 permits for women and 130 for transgender drivers (up to 90 women and 10 transgender permits per district).

questions.subject: Schemes
questions.q: What is the total outlay of the GOBARdhan scheme whose operational guidelines were issued in September 2026?
questions.e: The government operationalised the Rs 23,731-crore GOBARdhan scheme (2026-27 to 2035-36) on 15 September 2026, with assured CBG offtake up to 100% and an administered price of Rs 2,110 per MMBTU until 31 March 2036, implemented by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.

questions.subject: SciTech
questions.q: Which European company's rocket became the first privately developed rocket from continental Europe to reach orbit in September 2026?
questions.e: Germany's Isar Aerospace flew its two-stage Spectrum rocket into orbit from Andoya Spaceport, Norway, on 5 September 2026 (mission 'Onward and Upward'), carrying five CubeSats and one technology experiment.

questions.subject: SciTech
questions.q: What did the successful 9 September 2026 ISRO hot test at Mahendragiri involve?
o: An upgraded CE20 cryogenic engine for Gaganyaan
questions.e: ISRO successfully hot-tested an upgraded CE20 cryogenic engine (thrust raised to 22 tonnes) at Mahendragiri on 9 September 2026; Chairman V Narayanan said the first uncrewed Gaganyaan flight is targeted within 2026 and the crewed flight by early 2028.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Why did the UFBU defer the three-day nationwide bank strike planned for 28–30 September 2026?
o: The IBA agreed to a high-level committee on the five-day-week demand
The strike was declared illegal by a court
The government announced an immediate wage hike
The RBI ordered all banks to stay open
questions.e: On 27 September 2026 the UFBU deferred the 28–30 September strike after the IBA assured it would form a high-level committee to deliberate on declaring all Saturdays holidays (the five-day-week demand); SBI confirmed branches would function normally.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: According to PM Modi's 27 September 2026 Mann Ki Baat address, how many families had been recorded in the Census 2027 first phase?
questions.e: PM Modi said on 27 September 2026 that the Census 2027 first phase is nearly complete across all States/UTs with data of over 32 crore families recorded, and 2.6 crore people had self-enumerated digitally via mobile without uploading documents.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Where is the 11th Annual Meeting of the AIIB Board of Governors being held on 28 September 2026?
questions.e: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman is in Qatar (27–29 September 2026) for the 11th AIIB Board of Governors meeting in Doha, attending as India's Governor; India is the AIIB's second-largest shareholder.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: What was India's consumer confidence score in September 2026 as per Ipsos?
questions.e: India's consumer confidence rose 1.6 points to 66.9 in September 2026 (Ipsos), retaining the top rank among 30 countries; the Employment sub-index gained 3.7 points while the global index held at 48.4.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: Who chaired the 28 September 2026 meeting that formalised Delhi-NCR's winter pollution action plan?
questions.e: Union Environment Minister Bhupendra Yadav chaired the 28 September 2026 meeting with Delhi CM Rekha Gupta and CAQM officials, formalising a permanent institutional action plan — vehicle curbs, work-from-home and construction bans — for winter pollution.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: What did the Supreme Court say on 28 September 2026 about recent rape cases in Delhi?
o: They reflected a ‘failure of law enforcement’ and accountability must be fixed
It ordered immediate President's Rule in Delhi
It banned media reporting of such cases
It transferred all cases to the CBI
questions.e: On 28 September 2026 the Supreme Court pushed for accountability over the recent spate of rape cases in Delhi and neighbouring districts, calling them a ‘failure of law enforcement’, and directed its administration to file a PIL on the issue.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: For which two states did the Centre announce drought-assessment teams on 28 September 2026?
questions.e: Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan announced on 28 September 2026 that the Centre would send teams to assess drought in Karnataka and Maharashtra as the southwest monsoon wound down.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: On which date did the Rajya Sabha pass the Gig Workers Social Security and Welfare Bill, 2026?
questions.e: The Rajya Sabha passed the Bill on 29 September 2026 (the Lok Sabha had cleared it on 22 September).

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: Which agency will implement the Gig Workers Social Security and Welfare Bill, 2026?
questions.e: The Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) will be the implementing agency.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: Under the UPI MDR framework effective 15 October 2026, above what transaction value does the 0.4% MDR apply on specified person-to-merchant payments?
questions.e: MDR of 0.4% applies to specified P2M UPI transactions above ₹2,000 (capped at ₹300 for ₹75,000+).

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: What was India's IIP growth in August 2026?
questions.e: The Index of Industrial Production grew 8% y/y in August 2026, beating the 6.5% Reuters poll estimate.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: The Pashudhan Bima Portal, launched on 28 September 2026, is a single digital platform for:
questions.e: Launched by the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying, it covers policy issuance to claim settlement for livestock insurance.

questions.subject: Science
questions.q: TakeMe2Space's planned 2028 mission will be India's first:
questions.e: The Hyderabad startup plans two 100-kg MOI satellites on a SpaceX Falcon 9 (Waymaker 2 rideshare) for an orbital data centre.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: NMDC's ₹5,427-crore integrated project commissioned on 27–28 September 2026 is located in:
questions.e: The project — Bacheli processing plant, 15 MTPA slurry pipeline and 2 MTPA Nagarnar pellet plant — is in Chhattisgarh.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: The ‘Shram Samvad’ campaign on labour codes will cover industrial clusters across how many districts?
questions.e: Launched 28 September 2026 by Labour Minister Mansukh Mandaviya, it covers 316 districts across all 36 states/UTs over 90 days.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: On 29 September 2026, on the proposed MDR for specified UPI merchant transactions above Rs 2,000, the Supreme Court:
o: Refused an interim stay and sought responses in four weeks
Referred it to a larger bench
questions.e: The Court declined interim relief; the Centre, RBI and NPCI must respond in four weeks. Next hearing reported 13 October.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: India's IIP grew ___ year-on-year in August 2026, with manufacturing at 9.0%.
questions.e: IIP grew 8.0% YoY in August 2026, with manufacturing output up 9.0%.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: A Reuters poll (18-28 Sep 2026) found 35 of 61 economists expect the RBI's 5-7 October MPC to:
o: Raise the repo rate 25 bps to 5.50%
questions.e: 35 of 61 expected a 25-bps hike to 5.50% - the first hike since February 2023.

questions.subject: Sports
questions.q: Neeru Dhanda won gold in the women's individual trap at the 2026 Asian Games, becoming:
o: The first Indian woman to win individual Asian Games gold in trap

questions.e: Navi Pillay served as a judge of the ICTR (1995–2003, including four years as president), as an ICC judge (2003–2012), and as UN High Commissioner for Human Rights (2008–2014). She was never President of the ICJ.

questions.subject: Awards
questions.q: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences, awarded to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford, is conferred by which institution?
questions.e: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announced the 2026 Economics Prize for Hall and Woodford on 12 October 2026 for their microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation.

questions.subject: International
questions.q: Which Saudi airport was attacked on 10 October 2026 in the Houthi escalation that disrupted India–Saudi flights?
questions.e: Following escalating Houthi attacks, including the 10 October attack on Riyadh's airport, Indian carriers suspended Saudi flights (Air India/Air India Express till 20 October, IndiGo till 24 October) and India opened an additional control room in Makkah for pilgrims.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: What is the reported significance of INS Samarthak, commissioned into the Indian Navy on 17 October 2026?
o: First aircraft carrier built in India
First major warship built by a private shipyard
First vessel with an all-women crew
questions.e: INS Samarthak, commissioned on 17 October 2026, is an indigenously designed and built multi-purpose vessel reported as the first major warship built by a private shipyard in India.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: The NPPA capped the trade margin on 137 anti-cancer drugs at what percentage of MRP?
questions.e: NPPA capped the trade margin at 30% of MRP for 137 anti-cancer drugs, cutting prices by up to 70% effective 9 November 2026.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: The Supreme Court ruled internet access a fundamental right under which constitutional provisions (17 Oct 2026)?
questions.e: The Supreme Court held that children cannot face a blanket ban on internet access, reading it as a fundamental right under Article 21 read with Article 19(1)(a).

questions.subject: SciTech
questions.q: After completing the Crew Module–Service Module separation tests, what is the next milestone of the Gaganyaan programme?
questions.e: ISRO completed the Crew Module–Service Module separation tests at VSSC; the G1 uncrewed mission is the next milestone of the Gaganyaan programme.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: On 7 October 2026, the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee raised the policy repo rate by 25 basis points. What is the new repo rate?
questions.e: The MPC voted unanimously to raise the repo rate from 5.25% to 5.50% — the first hike since February 2023 — and shifted the policy stance to 'calibrated tightening'.

questions.subject: International Relations
questions.q: In October 2026, the US President waived provisions of the Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act (SRIA), pausing threatened tariffs of up to 100% on buyers of Russian oil such as India, for how long?
questions.e: The waiver announced on 17 October 2026 is a 60-day pause to study the economic impact. Think tank GTRI called it temporary relief, not lasting certainty.

questions.subject: Economy
questions.q: The draft National Steel Policy released in October 2026 targets what crude steel capacity for India by 2047?
questions.e: The draft targets 604 MT crude steel capacity by 2047, with finished steel demand of 505 MT, per-capita consumption of 302 kg and exports of 45 MT, alongside decarbonisation.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.q: In its 17 October 2026 judgment, the Supreme Court held that the right to access and use the internet is a fundamental right under which provisions, expressly extending it to children?
questions.e: A Bench of Justices J. B. Pardiwala and K. Vinod Chandran held that internet access is a fundamental right under Article 21 read with Article 19(1)(a), and that children enjoy it equally.

questions.subject: Defence
questions.q: In October 2026, India test-fired the Agni-Prime missile for the first time from which platform?
questions.e: The rail-based launch added a new dimension to India's strategic deterrence. Agni-Prime is a canisterised, solid-fuelled, two-stage medium-range ballistic missile with a range of up to 2,000 km.

capsules.subject: General
capsules.title: Mandhana named UNICEF India celebrity advocate (11 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: India women's cricket captain Smriti Mandhana was named a UNICEF India celebrity advocate on 11 October 2026, coinciding with the International Day of the Girl. She will champion equal opportunities, health and well-being for adolescent girls. Sachin Tendulkar, UNICEF's Regional Ambassador for South Asia, welcomed her appointment.

capsules.subject: General
capsules.title: Kuno: Aasha's eight-month-old cub found dead (12 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: An eight-month-old cub of Namibian cheetah Aasha — one of five born around February 2026 — was found dead at Kuno National Park, Madhya Pradesh, on 12 October 2026 after forest staff noticed only four cubs during morning monitoring. The cause is unknown pending the post-mortem. Kuno now holds 53 cheetahs (40 Indian-born, 15 free-ranging); India's total stands at 59, with four at Gandhi Sagar and two at Veerangana Durgavati Tiger Reserve.

capsules.subject: General
capsules.title: CPI inflation rises to 5.54% in September 2026 (data released 12 Oct)
capsules.body: India's retail (CPI) inflation rose to 5.54% year-on-year in September 2026 — the highest of 2026 under the new 2024-base series and the first crossing of the 5% mark — up from 4.83% in August, per provisional NSO data released 12 October. Food inflation jumped to 7.74%; onion inflation hit 108.09%. Rural inflation was 6.08% vs 4.88% urban. At its 7 October policy, the RBI raised the repo rate to 5.50% and lifted its FY27 inflation forecast to 5.2%.

capsules.subject: General
capsules.title: SAREX-2026: India's 12th national maritime rescue drill off Paradip (7–8 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The Indian Coast Guard conducted the 12th National Maritime Search & Rescue Exercise (SAREX-2026) off Paradip, Odisha, on 7–8 October 2026 under the theme 'Leveraging Technology to Strengthen SAR Preparedness and Maritime Safety'. The drill simulated a mass rescue: a passenger aircraft ditching with 228 people on board, its fuselage striking the container vessel MV Zumba. It was watched by 32 observers from 30 countries and reviewed by DG Paramesh Sivamani; Raksha Rajya Mantri Sanjay Seth inaugurated it on 7 October.

capsules.subject: General
capsules.title: US sanctions the ICC hours after Pillay's Peace Prize (9 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: On 9 October 2026, hours after the Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to Navi Pillay, the United States announced sanctions on the International Criminal Court, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio saying the administration would 'dismantle' the court 'brick by brick'. The Treasury issued a six-month waiver for companies to wind down dealings. The ICC condemned the move as an 'assault on the rule of law'; eight countries including Canada, Germany, France, Japan and the UK reaffirmed support for the court.

capsules.subject: Awards
capsules.title: Nobel Prizes 2026 — complete list as Economics award closes the week (12 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The 2026 Nobel Week (5–12 October) concluded on 12 October 2026 with the Economic Sciences prize to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford “for microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation”, awarded by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences. Other laureates: Medicine — Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, Georg Nagel (optogenetics); Physics — Francis Halzen (IceCube neutrinos); Chemistry — Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai (asymmetric synthesis); Literature — Anne Carson (Canada); Peace — Navanethem “Navi” Pillay (South Africa). Prize money: 12 million Swedish kronor; ceremonies on 10 December.

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: Exercise Tarang Shakti 2026 concludes at Jodhpur; F-35 flies in Indian skies for the first time (13 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The Indian Air Force’s flagship multilateral exercise Tarang Shakti 2026 concluded on 13 October 2026 at Jodhpur Airbase, Rajasthan — its second edition, with eight nations including India. About 150 domestic and foreign fighter aircraft flew 600+ sorties across 800 hours of complex aerial operations. The highlight: the US fifth-generation F-35 Lightning II flew in Indian airspace for the first time, alongside the US KC-135 tanker, UAE F-16s, French Rafales, and Germany’s A400M. Chief Air Chief Marshal Amarpreet Singh flew a Tejas on his final fighter-pilot sortie before retiring on 31 October; Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit takes over as Air Chief on 1 November. The next edition is scheduled in two years.

capsules.subject: Polity
capsules.title: SC: revised Form 6 ‘neither approved nor disapproved’; hearing on 27 October (12 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: On 12 October 2026, a Supreme Court bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana clarified it had “neither approved nor disapproved” the Election Commission’s revised Form 6 for voter registration, observing that its May 2026 Bihar SIR judgment pre-dated the July 2026 changes (which added ancestry/roll-linkage declarations). “Do not put words in our mouth,” the bench remarked on the ECI’s claim of court approval. Petitions challenging the form, including one by Priya Mishra, will be heard on 27 October 2026.

capsules.subject: Science & Tech
capsules.title: ISRO targets 15–20 October 2026 for NVS-03 NavIC launch aboard GSLV-F18
capsules.body: ISRO is preparing to launch NVS-03, the third of five second-generation NavIC navigation satellites, in a window of 15–20 October 2026 aboard the GSLV-F18 rocket from Sriharikota. Built on the I-2K platform (~2,250 kg), it carries L1/L5/S-band payloads and rubidium atomic clocks. It follows NVS-01 (2023) and the ill-fated NVS-02, which suffered a propulsion failure in January 2025. Only three NavIC satellites (IRNSS-1B, IRNSS-1I, NVS-01) currently provide positioning; NVS-03 would restore the minimum four needed for standalone navigation across India and 1,500 km beyond.

capsules.subject: Jobs
capsules.title: BPSC TRE 4.0 vacancies raised to 33,320; applications close 26 October 2026
capsules.body: The Bihar Public Service Commission raised the vacancy count for BPSC TRE 4.0 (Advt 15/2026) from 32,388 to 33,320 school-teacher posts (announced 7 October 2026). Online applications run 25 September – 26 October 2026 at bpsc.bih.nic.in for classes 1–12. Eligibility: graduation/post-graduation in the subject plus B.Ed/STET/CTET/D.El.Ed; age 18–37 (UR male), up to 40 (UR female/BC/EBC) and 42 (SC/ST) as on 1 January 2026. Fee: ₹750 (General/OBC/EWS), ₹200 (Bihar SC/ST, domicile women, PwD).

capsules.subject: Polity
capsules.title: Governor reshuffle across six states (12 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: President Droupadi Murmu announced a governor reshuffle on 12 October 2026: Braj Mohan Ram to Odisha, Dr Sudha Yadav to Karnataka, Dr Dhal Singh Bisen to Uttarakhand and Dushyant Gautam to Sikkim; Om Prakash Mathur was transferred from Sikkim to Kerala and Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar was appointed Governor of Tamil Nadu. Appointments take effect when the incumbents assume charge. Article 155 of the Constitution provides for appointment of governors by the President.

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: India-Czech defence industrial cooperation expanded (13 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh met the Czech Republic's First Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Industry and Trade Karel Havlicek in New Delhi on 13 October 2026. The two sides agreed to expand defence industrial cooperation, including joint ventures, in support of Make in India and Aatmanirbhar Bharat; the India-Czech Joint Defence Committee remains the key platform.

capsules.subject: Science
capsules.title: SpaceX CRS-35 launched to the ISS (13 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: SpaceX launched its 35th Commercial Resupply Services mission (CRS-35) on 13 October 2026: a Falcon 9 from pad 40, Cape Canaveral, carrying the Cargo Dragon with over 6,300 pounds of supplies. It delivered the fourth and final pair of Redwire Roll-Out Solar Arrays (each over 20 kW, 10+ year life) plus research into vision restoration, heart tissue, brain disorders and antibiotic-resistant bacteria.

capsules.subject: Technology
capsules.title: NVIDIA: RTX Spark laptops, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt, PAIR (13 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: NVIDIA announced on 13 October 2026 that RTX Spark laptops launch on 16 October, with Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB releasing 15 October — a 74-billion-parameter, 9-billion-active-parameter mixture-of-experts model compressed to 24 GB via 2-bit quantization, fully open source. Its PAIR tool (Personal AI Router) moved out of beta: free, open source, distributing AI workloads across PCs on a local network.

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: Cabinet approves IDBI Bank strategic sale to Fairfax for ₹52,878 crore (14 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: On 14 October 2026 the Union Cabinet approved the strategic restructuring of IDBI Bank, with Fairfax acquiring a stake for ₹52,878 crore — described as the largest-ever foreign direct investment in India’s financial sector. The government’s stake falls to 15% and LIC’s to 19%.

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: India–China trade deficit crosses $100 billion in 2026
capsules.body: India’s trade deficit with China crossed $100 billion in 2026, even as exports to China grew 40% in the first three quarters to $20 billion, according to data released by China’s General Administration of Customs on 14 October 2026.

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: RBI hikes repo rate to 5.50% on 7 October 2026 — first hike since February 2023
capsules.body: The RBI’s Monetary Policy Committee unanimously raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% and shifted the stance from neutral to calibrated tightening. The SDF stands at 5.25%, while the MSF and Bank Rate are at 5.75%. The MPC projected FY27 GDP growth at 7.1% and CPI inflation at 5.2%.

capsules.subject: Awards
capsules.title: Nobel Prizes 2026: complete winners list
capsules.body: Medicine (5 Oct): Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, Georg Nagel — optogenetics. Physics (6 Oct): Francis Halzen — IceCube Neutrino Observatory. Chemistry (7 Oct): Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai — asymmetric synthesis. Literature (8 Oct): Anne Carson (Canada). Peace (9 Oct): Navi Pillay. Economic Sciences (12 Oct): Robert Hall and Michael Woodford — microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation. Ceremonies on 10 December 2026; prize 12 million Swedish kronor.

capsules.subject: Polity
capsules.title: 1st BIMSTEC Home Ministers’ Meeting adopts Delhi Declaration
capsules.body: Interior ministers of all seven BIMSTEC member states, meeting in New Delhi under the chairmanship of Union Home Minister Amit Shah, unanimously adopted the Delhi Declaration — formalising regional counter-terror intelligence sharing, joint border policing, and common protocols against maritime smuggling and cross-border cyber financial fraud in the Bay of Bengal region.

capsules.subject: Governance
capsules.title: Lakshadweep becomes India’s first 100% literate Union Territory under ULLAS
capsules.body: Lakshadweep has been declared India’s first 100% literate Union Territory under ULLAS (Understanding of Lifelong Learning for All in Society), the Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram for adult literacy.

capsules.subject: International
capsules.title: Pope Leo XIV diagnosed with lung cancer
capsules.body: The Vatican confirmed that Pope Leo XIV has lung cancer - tests during surgery confirmed lung adenocarcinoma, and the lower lobe of his right lung was removed (Oct 2026). PM Modi wished him a full and speedy recovery.

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: Cabinet approves 78-day railway bonus
capsules.body: The Union Cabinet approved a 78-day productivity-linked bonus worth Rs 2,009.61 crore for over 11.4 lakh railway employees (Oct 2026).

capsules.subject: National
capsules.title: Meerut 'Blue Drum' murder verdict
capsules.body: A Meerut court sentenced Muskan Rastogi and Sahil Shukla to death for the murder of Saurabh Rajput in the 'Blue Drum' murder case (Oct 2026).

capsules.subject: General
capsules.title: Cabinet approves Fairfax ₹52,878 crore IDBI Bank deal (15 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The Union Cabinet approved Fairfax's ₹52,878 crore deal for IDBI Bank on 15 October 2026 — the country's biggest financial-sector FDI. The deal reduces the government's stake to 15% and LIC's to 19%, marking a major milestone in the strategic disinvestment of the bank.

capsules.subject: General
capsules.title: NSAP continued for 2026–31 with ₹53,428 crore outlay (15 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved the continuation of the Centrally Sponsored National Social Assistance Programme for a five-year cycle (2026–27 to 2030–31) with a total outlay of ₹53,428 crore. The programme gives monthly pensions and lump-sum assistance to elderly persons, widows and persons with severe disabilities living below the poverty line, operationalising Article 41 of the Constitution.

capsules.subject: General
capsules.title: RBI hikes repo rate to 5.50%, shifts to calibrated tightening (7 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: At its October 5–7, 2026 meeting under Governor Sanjay Malhotra, the RBI's MPC unanimously raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% — the first hike in nearly three years — and changed the stance from neutral to 'calibrated tightening'. SDF stands at 5.25% and MSF/Bank Rate at 5.75%. FY27 GDP growth is projected at 7.1% and CPI inflation at 5.2%.

capsules.subject: General
capsules.title: SC mandates insurance on all offline railway tickets from 27 Oct 2026 (15 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: A Supreme Court Bench of Justices Ahsanuddin Amanullah and R. Mahadevan directed that tickets sold at counters at every railway station nationwide must include travel insurance coverage identical to that of online bookings, with the order taking effect from 27 October 2026.

capsules.subject: General
capsules.title: President accepts L Murugan's resignation from Union Council of Ministers (15 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: President Droupadi Murmu accepted Dr L Murugan's resignation from the Union Council of Ministers with immediate effect on 15 October 2026, acting on the advice of Prime Minister Narendra Modi under Article 75(2) of the Constitution. The communique gave no reason for the resignation.

capsules.subject: General
capsules.title: Houthis strike Aramco headquarters in overnight attack (15 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: Iran-backed Houthi rebels hit the headquarters of the Saudi state-owned oil company Aramco in an overnight strike, two regional officials said on 15 October 2026, damaging the offices of the firm's chief executive and other top officials.

capsules.subject: General
capsules.title: India–China trade deficit crosses $100 billion in 2026 (15 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: Fresh customs data reported on 15 October 2026 shows India's trade deficit with China has crossed $100 billion in 2026. Indian exports to China grew 40% in the first nine months, but the overall gap keeps widening — a key data point for trade-policy questions.

capsules.subject: General
capsules.title: Tyeb Mehta's 'Rickshaw Puller' fetches record ₹69.1 crore (15 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: Tyeb Mehta's 'Rickshaw Puller' fetched a record ₹69.1 crore at an auction in Mumbai on 15 October 2026 — the highest price ever recorded for the legendary painter's work, making it a notable art-market data point.

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: WPI inflation hits 11.39% in September 2026
capsules.body: India's wholesale price inflation rose to 11.39% in September 2026 from 9.92% in August — the highest in the revised WPI series (base 2022-23, introduced June 2026), per provisional Commerce Ministry data released 14 October 2026. Fuel & power led at 25.85% (crude petroleum & natural gas 57.32%), manufactured products hit a series high of 9.76% and the food index rose to 8.66%. The West Asia war and the Strait of Hormuz blockade pushed up global crude and fertiliser costs, with spillover into food and commodity prices.

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: IDBI Bank: Fairfax's ₹52,878-crore takeover — India's biggest financial-sector FDI deal (16 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved the sale of the government's 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank to Fairfax Financial Holdings for ₹52,878 crore, reported as the largest financial-sector FDI deal in India. Reports indicate plans to explore consolidating Digit and IIFL Capital operations with the lender. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: RBI October 2026 policy: repo rate at 5.50%, stance shifts to 'calibrated tightening' (7 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: The MPC raised the repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50% — the first hike since February 2023 — shifting stance from 'neutral' to 'calibrated tightening'. Governor Sanjay Malhotra said rate cuts are off the table in the near term. SDF: 5.25%; MSF and Bank Rate: 5.75%. FY27 GDP growth projected at 7.1%; CPI inflation at 5.2%. Next MPC: 2–4 December 2026. (Dated: 7 Oct 2026)

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: RBI tightens liquidity: daily CRR maintenance at 99% from 16 Oct 2026; ₹25,000-crore OMO sale
capsules.body: The RBI raised the minimum daily CRR maintenance to 99% of the prescribed requirement from the fortnight beginning 16 October 2026 and announced an open market operation sale of ₹25,000 crore of government securities on 13 October to absorb surplus liquidity. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: INS Tarkash joins IBSAMAR IX; Mountain Guardian 2026 ends 18 Oct; new Air Chief on 31 Oct (16 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: INS Tarkash is participating in the ninth edition of IBSAMAR, the India–Brazil–South Africa maritime exercise, in South Africa. The India–UAE exercise Mountain Guardian 2026 (Chaubatia, Uttarakhand) ends on 18 October, and Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit becomes Chief of the Air Staff on 31 October. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh will represent India at the SCO heads-of-government summit. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

capsules.subject: Science & Tech
capsules.title: SPACEO Prime: Muks Robotics wins ISRO project for India's first humanoid space worker (16 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: Pune-based Muks Robotics secured an ISRO project to develop SPACEO Prime, India's first humanoid space worker, for assisting astronauts and hazardous operations. Separately, Kerala's Genrobotics won an ISRO contract for a high-precision boom arm for satellite missions, and IIIT-Dharwad's Team Icarus finished fourth in the ISRO Robotics Challenge–URSC 2026 (₹2 lakh prize) with an autonomous Mars-like-environment quadcopter. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

capsules.subject: Science & Tech
capsules.title: CoreWeave enters India: 240 MW AI data-centre campus in Navi Mumbai with NVIDIA Vera Rubin (8 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: CoreWeave, with AdaniConneX, will build a 240 MW AI data-centre campus (three 80 MW buildings) at Taloja, Navi Mumbai, deploying the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform. The first phase is expected to be operational by mid-2028, with direct liquid cooling for GPU halls. (Dated: 8 Oct 2026)

capsules.subject: Polity
capsules.title: AI regulation: India to release AI consultation paper within a month; model empanelment planned (10 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw told a World Bank event that India will release a consultation paper on AI within about a month to frame techno-legal regulations covering AI safety, humanity, skilling, inclusivity, deepfakes, AI hallucination and mental health. The government will also empanel AI models for official use and published a three-to-four-year GPU roadmap for AI inference. (Dated: 10 Oct 2026)

capsules.subject: Sports
capsules.title: Asian Games 2026: India 4th with 85 medals; IND–WI T20I decider on 17 Oct in Bengaluru (16 Oct 2026)
capsules.body: India finished 4th at the Asian Games 2026 with 85 medals (21 gold, 27 silver, 37 bronze), tying Uzbekistan on golds. The NSDF, SAI and IOCL launched a ₹40 crore two-year boxing initiative. The India–West Indies T20I decider is on 17 October at Bengaluru's Chinnaswamy Stadium (series 2–2; WI won the 4th T20I by 24 runs — Shai Hope 102*, Keemo Paul 5/41; India won the ODI series 2–1). Asian Para Games (Aichi-Nagoya) run 18–24 October; Summer Youth Olympics in Dakar run 31 October–13 November. (Dated: 16 Oct 2026)

capsules.subject: Environment
capsules.title: India's Ramsar tally reaches 103
capsules.body: On 15 October 2026, Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav announced the designation of Sukhna Wetland (Chandigarh's first Ramsar site) and Sauj Jheel (Mainpuri, Uttar Pradesh), taking India's Ramsar tally from 101 to 103. Mainpuri became the only district in Uttar Pradesh with two Ramsar sites.

capsules.subject: Polity
capsules.title: SC: conversion does not preserve backward-class reservation
capsules.body: A Supreme Court bench of Justices Prashant Kumar Mishra and Shree Chandrashekhar upheld a Madras High Court judgment holding that a person converting from Hinduism to Islam cannot claim Backward Class Muslim reservation based on pre-conversion caste status, upholding the striking down of a 2024 Tamil Nadu government order (15 October 2026).

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: RBI hikes repo to 5.50%; 'calibrated tightening'
capsules.body: On 7 October 2026, the RBI's MPC unanimously raised the repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50% — the first hike since February 2023 — and shifted the stance to 'calibrated tightening'. SDF at 5.25%, MSF and Bank Rate at 5.75%; FY27 GDP growth projected at 7.1% and CPI inflation at 5.2%.

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: Cabinet approves IDBI Bank stake sale to Fairfax
capsules.body: The Union Cabinet approved the sale of a stake in IDBI Bank to Fairfax for Rs. 52,878 crore on 14 October 2026.

capsules.subject: Sports
capsules.title: Bhuvneshwar Kumar returns to India's T20I squad
capsules.body: Bhuvneshwar Kumar was added to India's squad on 16 October 2026 for the fifth T20I against the West Indies in Bengaluru (17 October 2026), marking his return to the T20I setup for the first time since November 2022, after Arshdeep Singh sustained a shoulder injury. The series is level at 2-2.

capsules.subject: Governance
capsules.title: NSAP continued for 2026-31; railway bonus approved
capsules.body: The Cabinet approved continuation of the National Social Assistance Programme for 2026-31 and a Rs. 2,009.61 crore productivity-linked bonus for railway employees on 15 October 2026. NSAP was launched on 15 August 1995 under Article 41 (Directive Principles) with 100% central assistance.

capsules.subject: National
capsules.title: Jantar Mantar denotified as protest site — Verified: 17 Oct 2026
capsules.body: Following recommendations of a committee constituted by the Union Home Ministry, Delhi Police removed Jantar Mantar from the list of designated protest sites. Ramlila Ground, Burari Ground and CBD Ground in East Delhi were named as alternative venues for demonstrations (reported 13 Oct 2026).

capsules.subject: International
capsules.title: Nobel Peace Prize 2026: Navi Pillay honoured; row over India's silence — Verified: 17 Oct 2026
capsules.body: South African jurist Navanetham (Navi) Pillay, of Tamil origin, was awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize on 9 October for her efforts to promote peace and international law, including work against war crimes and apartheid. The award drew political attention in India after the government did not publicly congratulate her.

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: 2026 Economics Nobel: Hall and Woodford — Verified: 17 Oct 2026
capsules.body: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences to Robert E. Hall (Stanford) and Michael Woodford (Columbia) 'for microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation'. Their work shows how policy expectations of households and firms shape booms, recessions and inflation — central to how central banks like the RBI anchor inflation.

capsules.subject: International
capsules.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia: Indian flights suspended; Makkah control room opened
capsules.body: Escalating Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia — including an attack on Riyadh's airport on 10 October — forced Indian airlines to suspend flights: Air India and Air India Express cancelled Riyadh, Dammam and Jeddah flights till 20 October (full refunds); IndiGo till 24 October; Akasa Air Riyadh till 24 October and Jeddah till 21 October. The Indian Embassy in Riyadh issued a fresh advisory; Umrah pilgrims may reroute via Bahrain, Kuwait or Qatar; India opened an additional control room in Makkah and raised the escalation at the UN Security Council.

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: INS Samarthak commissioned: first major warship from a private yard
capsules.body: The Indian Navy commissioned INS Samarthak, an indigenously designed and built multi-purpose vessel — reported as the first major warship built by a private shipyard in India — on 17 October 2026.

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: Forex $726.03 bn; rupee at 94.71; Maldives swap rollover
capsules.body: India's foreign exchange reserves stood at USD 726.03 billion as on 9 October 2026 (RBI), down USD 8.58 billion in the week and about USD 60 billion over six weeks as RBI defended the rupee; the rupee gained 1.9% in the week to close at ₹94.71. Bank credit grew 19.4% YoY and deposits 17.8% YoY (30 September). The MEA rolled over a ₹3,000 crore currency swap with Maldives from 23 October 2026 under the SAARC framework (2024–27). The WTO raised its 2026 merchandise trade growth forecast to 3.9%.

capsules.subject: Environment
capsules.title: India's Ramsar tally reaches 103 (Sukhna Wetland, Sauj Jheel)
capsules.body: India's Ramsar site tally reached 103 with the inclusion of Sukhna Wetland and Sauj Jheel. The government also approved India's accession to SIOFA (Southern Indian Ocean Fisheries Agreement) to expand high-seas fishing opportunities.

capsules.subject: SciTech
capsules.title: Gaganyaan CM–SM separation tests done; G1 mission next
capsules.body: ISRO completed the Crew Module–Service Module (CM–SM) separation tests for Gaganyaan at VSSC; the G1 uncrewed mission is next. India operationalised its resident mission in Costa Rica, and the 8th India–UK Science & Innovation Council met, with a new India–UK technology-translation partnership launched. India's space economy is about USD 9 billion now and is projected at USD 40–45 billion in 7–8 years (PIB).

capsules.subject: Polity
capsules.title: SC: internet access a fundamental right; NPPA caps drug margins
capsules.body: The Supreme Court ruled that children cannot face a blanket age ban on the internet: access is a fundamental right under Article 21 read with Article 19(1)(a). Separately, the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority capped the trade margin at 30% of MRP on 137 anti-cancer drugs, cutting prices by up to 70%, effective 9 November 2026.

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: RBI hikes repo rate to 5.50% — first increase since February 2023
capsules.body: On 7 October 2026, the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee under Governor Sanjay Malhotra voted unanimously to raise the policy repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% — the first hike since February 2023. The stance moved from 'neutral' to 'calibrated tightening' (4–2 vote). Corridor: SDF 5.25%; MSF and Bank Rate 5.75%. The RBI projects FY27 real GDP growth of 7.1% and CPI inflation of 5.2%.

capsules.subject: International Relations
capsules.title: US waives Russia-oil sanctions for 60 days; India gets breathing room
capsules.body: On 17 October 2026, US President Donald Trump waived key provisions of the Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act (SRIA), pausing threatened tariffs of up to 100% on buyers of Russian oil and gas, including India. Secretary of State Marco Rubio framed it as a 60-day pause to study economic impacts. Think tank GTRI called it temporary relief, not lasting certainty, urging India to buy oil on commercial terms and prepare for renewed pressure.

capsules.subject: Economy
capsules.title: Draft National Steel Policy: 604 MT capacity by 2047
capsules.body: Released on 17 October 2026, the draft National Steel Policy targets 604 million tonnes of crude steel capacity by 2047, with finished steel demand of 505 MT, per-capita consumption of 302 kg and exports of 45 MT. It pushes a circular economy, value-added production and decarbonisation — average carbon intensity to fall from 2.54 to about 1.54 tCO2 per tonne of crude steel by 2047.

capsules.subject: SciTech
capsules.title: India's space economy may grow nearly five-fold
capsules.body: On 17 October 2026, Minister of State for Space Jitendra Singh said India's space economy — worth about $9 billion today — could reach $40–45 billion in the next seven to eight years, driven by private companies, not government capability alone.

capsules.subject: Defence
capsules.title: Agni-Prime test-fired from rail-based launcher — a first
capsules.body: In October 2026, India successfully test-fired the Agni-Prime missile from a specially designed rail-based mobile launcher — the first rail launch of this missile. Agni-P is a next-generation, canisterised, solid-fuelled, two-stage medium-range ballistic missile with a range of up to 2,000 km.
